data.value: Act IV · The Badge Has Teeth

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.rain-office.Body
data.value: Rain writes crooked lines down the office glass. The city outside is all wet pavement, tired neon and the kind of traffic that never quite stops. At twelve seventeen, Evelyn Vane walks in without an appointment. Her husband, Arthur Vane, left the Hotel Mirabelle yesterday evening and never came home. The police logged it as a rich man taking a private night away. Evelyn does not believe them. Neither does the envelope of cash she sets on your desk.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.ask-timeline
data.value: Start with the timeline. Make her account precise.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.ask-ivory-room
data.value: Ask why the Ivory Room name is written on the back of Arthur's hotel card.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.take-case
data.value: Take the case and go straight to the Hotel Mirabelle.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.timeline-clean.Body
data.value: Evelyn answers in the clipped rhythm of someone who has rehearsed the story because nobody official listened the first time. Arthur checked into room 306 at 6:42 p.m. He called home at 8:03. A hotel porter saw him return from the street at 9:11. At 9:28, the switchboard recorded an outgoing connection from his room. After that, seventeen minutes are missing from the hotel's internal log. Evelyn never mentions those seventeen minutes until you make her walk through the sequence twice.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.timeline-to-hotel
data.value: Go to the Mirabelle before the night staff changes.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Scene.timeline-frayed.Body
data.value: The sequence refuses to settle. Evelyn remembers the call, the hotel, the rain, and the fact that Arthur sounded afraid, but exact times slide away from her. Whether that is grief, exhaustion or concealment is impossible to tell tonight. You still get one useful fact: room 306, Hotel Mirabelle.

data.name: Adventure.dead-mans-hand.Choice.frayed-to-hotel
data.value: Work with what you have. Go to the Mirabelle.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Scene.crooked-crown.Body
data.value: Rain needles the windows of the Crooked Crown and turns the road outside into black glass. Mara Vey, the innkeeper, sets a sealed letter beside your cup without asking whether you want it. "A stranger paid well to make sure this reached you." The wax is black. The mark pressed into it is a stag with one antler broken away.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.open-letter
data.value: Break the seal and read the letter.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.inspect-seal
data.value: Inspect the seal before touching the letter.

data.name: Adventure.black-stag.Choice.question-keeper
data.value: Watch Mara carefully and ask who delivered it.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.greyhaven-road.Body
data.value: By the time the road falls toward Greyhaven, the sea has disappeared behind a wall of pearl-grey fog. Gulls wheel above fields you can no longer see, and every fence post wears a crust of salt. You came for a quiet night's shelter. The village below looks as though it has forgotten how to offer one.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Scene.fog-signs.Body
data.value: The fog is wrong. Wind bends the grass inland, but the bank over Greyhaven barely shifts. Beneath the ordinary smell of brine sits something colder: iron, old stone and extinguished candles. Whatever waits below is not only weather.

data.name: Adventure.drowned-bell.Choice.descend-aware
data.value: Keep that in mind and enter the village.
